__inputs.name: DS_FABRIC
__inputs.label: Fabric Eventhouse
__inputs.description: Azure Data Explorer datasource configured for this demo KQL database

title: Fabric RTI Traces
description: Distributed traces from Fabric Eventhouse: find a trace, follow it span by span, and see how services call each other.

list.name: database
list.label: KQL database
list.description: Eventhouse KQL database that stores the OTEL tables.

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: All environments : all, AKS : aks, Container Apps job : demo

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: All services : all, gateway : gateway, checkout : checkout, inventory : inventory, payment : payment, shipping : shipping, notifications : notifications, postgres : postgres

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Trace ID (blank = latest)
list.description: Leave blank for the newest settled multi-span trace, or click a TraceID in Find a trace.

list.name: trace_view
list.label: Show
list.description: Order or filter the Find a trace table.
list.query: Most recent : recent, Failed only : errors, Slowest first : slowest

panels.title: Trace summary
panels.description: Traces that touch the selected service in the time window. Counts include traces still being ingested.

targets.query:
OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where ${environment:singlequote} == "all" or Environment == ${environment:singlequote}
| summarize Start=min(StartTime), Finish=max(EndTime), Spans=count(),
    ErrorSpans=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"), MatchingService=countif(${service:singlequote} == "all" or Service == ${service:singlequote}) by TraceID
| where MatchingService > 0
| summarize Traces=count(), Failed=countif(ErrorSpans > 0),
    P95DurationMs=percentile((Finish - Start) / 1ms, 95), SpansPerTrace=avg(Spans)
| project Traces, FailedPercent=iff(Traces == 0, real(null), 100.0 * Failed / Traces), P95DurationMs, SpansPerTrace

panels.title: Find a trace
panels.description: Up to 100 traces. Click a TraceID to open its waterfall or its logs. Use Show to list failed or slowest traces.

targets.query:
OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where ${environment:singlequote} == "all" or Environment == ${environment:singlequote}
| summarize Start=min(StartTime), Finish=max(EndTime), Spans=count(),
    ErrorSpans=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"), Services=make_set(Service, 16),
    Root=take_anyif(SpanName, isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000"), MatchingService=countif(${service:singlequote} == "all" or Service == ${service:singlequote})
    by TraceID, Environment
| where MatchingService > 0
| where ${trace_view:singlequote} != "errors" or ErrorSpans > 0
| extend DurationMs=(Finish - Start) / 1ms
| extend Rank=iff(${trace_view:singlequote} == "slowest", DurationMs, (Start - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1ms)
| top 100 by Rank desc
| project Start, TraceID, Root=iff(isempty(Root), "(root pending)", Root), Status=iff(ErrorSpans > 0, "Error", "OK"),
    DurationMs, Spans, Services=strcat_array(array_sort_asc(Services), ", "), Environment

panels.title: Service map
panels.description: Calls between services, derived from parent and child spans. Inside each node: p95 latency and requests per minute. The red arc is the error share. Click a node for details.

targets.query:
let spans = materialize(OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where ${environment:singlequote} == "all" or Environment == ${environment:singlequote}
| project TraceID, SpanID, ParentID, Service, SpanName, SpanKind, SpanStatus, DurationMs=(EndTime - StartTime) / 1ms);
let minutes = max_of(1.0, ($__timeTo - $__timeFrom) / 1m);
let calls = union
    (spans
    | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_SERVER" and not(isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")
    | join kind=inner (spans | project TraceID, ParentID=SpanID, Caller=Service) on TraceID, ParentID
    | where Caller != Service
    | project source=Caller, target=Service, SpanStatus, DurationMs),
    (spans
    | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_CLIENT" and SpanName startswith "demo.postgres"
    | project source=Service, target="postgres", SpanStatus, DurationMs)
| where ${service:singlequote} == "all" or source == ${service:singlequote} or target == ${service:singlequote};
let members = union (calls | project Node=source), (calls | project Node=target) | distinct Node;
union
    (spans | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_SERVER" | project Node=Service, Kind="service", SpanStatus, DurationMs),
    (spans | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_CLIENT" and SpanName startswith "demo.postgres"
        | project Node="postgres", Kind="database", SpanStatus, DurationMs)
| where Node in (members) or ${service:singlequote} == "all" or Node == ${service:singlequote}
| summarize Calls=count(), Errors=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"), P95Ms=percentile(DurationMs, 95),
    Kind=take_any(Kind) by Node
| project id=Node, title=Node, subtitle=Kind, mainstat=strcat(tolong(round(P95Ms)), " ms"),
    secondarystat=strcat(round(Calls / minutes, 1), " req/min"),
    arc__failed=todouble(Errors) / Calls, arc__ok=1.0 - todouble(Errors) / Calls,
    detail__requests=Calls, detail__error_percent=round(100.0 * Errors / Calls, 2)
| take 100

let spans = materialize(OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where ${environment:singlequote} == "all" or Environment == ${environment:singlequote}
| project TraceID, SpanID, ParentID, Service, SpanName, SpanKind, SpanStatus, DurationMs=(EndTime - StartTime) / 1ms);
let minutes = max_of(1.0, ($__timeTo - $__timeFrom) / 1m);
let calls = union
    (spans
    | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_SERVER" and not(isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")
    | join kind=inner (spans | project TraceID, ParentID=SpanID, Caller=Service) on TraceID, ParentID
    | where Caller != Service
    | project source=Caller, target=Service, SpanStatus, DurationMs),
    (spans
    | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_CLIENT" and SpanName startswith "demo.postgres"
    | project source=Service, target="postgres", SpanStatus, DurationMs)
| where ${service:singlequote} == "all" or source == ${service:singlequote} or target == ${service:singlequote};
calls

panels.title: Trace waterfall
panels.description: Every span of the selected trace on a timeline. Blank Trace ID shows the newest settled multi-span trace (at least a minute old, no missing parents). Expand a span for its attributes, resource and correlated logs.

targets.query:
let requested_trace = ${trace_id:singlequote};
let windowed = materialize(OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where ${environment:singlequote} == "all" or Environment == ${environment:singlequote});
let latest_trace = toscalar(windowed
    | summarize First=min(StartTime), Spans=count(), Roots=countif(isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000"),
        Ids=make_set(SpanID, 128), Parents=make_set_if(ParentID, not(isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000"), 128),
        MatchingService=countif(${service:singlequote} == "all" or Service == ${service:singlequote}) by TraceID
    | where First < ago(1m) and Roots > 0 and Spans > 1 and MatchingService > 0
    | where array_length(set_difference(Parents, Ids)) == 0
    | top 1 by First desc
    | project TraceID);
let selected_trace = iff(isempty(requested_trace) or requested_trace == "latest", latest_trace, requested_trace);
let span_logs = OTELLogs
    | where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    | where TraceID == selected_trace
    | summarize logs=make_list(bag_pack("timestamp", tolong((Timestamp - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1ms),
        "fields", bag_pack("level", tolower(SeverityText), "message", Body,
            "outcome", tostring(LogsAttributes["outcome"])))) by SpanID;
windowed
| where TraceID == selected_trace
| join kind=leftouter span_logs on SpanID
| project traceID=TraceID, spanID=SpanID, parentSpanID=iff(ParentID == "0000000000000000", "", ParentID),
    operationName=SpanName, serviceName=Service,
    serviceTags=bag_remove_keys(ResourceAttributes, dynamic(["service.name"])),
    startTime=(StartTime - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1ms, duration=(EndTime - StartTime) / 1ms,
    tags=TraceAttributes, logs=coalesce(logs, dynamic([])),
    ["kind"]=tolower(replace_string(SpanKind, "SPAN_KIND_", "")),
    statusCode=case(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR", 2, SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_OK", 1, 0),
    statusMessage=SpanStatusMessage
| order by startTime asc
| take 200

panels.title: Logs in this trace
panels.description: Log records that carry the selected trace ID, in time order. Logs can arrive a little after their spans.

targets.query:
let requested_trace = ${trace_id:singlequote};
let windowed = materialize(OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where ${environment:singlequote} == "all" or Environment == ${environment:singlequote});
let latest_trace = toscalar(windowed
    | summarize First=min(StartTime), Spans=count(), Roots=countif(isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000"),
        Ids=make_set(SpanID, 128), Parents=make_set_if(ParentID, not(isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000"), 128),
        MatchingService=countif(${service:singlequote} == "all" or Service == ${service:singlequote}) by TraceID
    | where First < ago(1m) and Roots > 0 and Spans > 1 and MatchingService > 0
    | where array_length(set_difference(Parents, Ids)) == 0
    | top 1 by First desc
    | project TraceID);
let selected_trace = iff(isempty(requested_trace) or requested_trace == "latest", latest_trace, requested_trace);
OTELLogs
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where TraceID == selected_trace
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Scenario=tostring(LogsAttributes["demo.scenario"]),
    Outcome=tostring(LogsAttributes["outcome"])
| project Timestamp, Line=strcat("[", Service, "] ", Body, " (", Scenario, ", ", Outcome, ")"), level=tolower(SeverityText), Service, SpanID, TraceID
| order by Timestamp asc
| take 200

panels.title: Traces per minute
panels.description: Traces by start minute, split into OK and failed (any span in error).

targets.query:
OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where ${environment:singlequote} == "all" or Environment == ${environment:singlequote}
| summarize Start=min(StartTime), ErrorSpans=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"),
    MatchingService=countif(${service:singlequote} == "all" or Service == ${service:singlequote}) by TraceID, Environment
| where MatchingService > 0
| summarize Traces=count() by WindowStart=bin(Start, 1m), Environment, Outcome=iff(ErrorSpans > 0, "failed", "ok")
| project WindowStart, Traces, Series=strcat(Environment, " / ", Outcome)
| order by WindowStart asc

panels.title: Where time goes - p95 self time
panels.description: Time spent inside each operation, excluding its child spans. The longest bars are the bottlenecks.

targets.query:
let spans = materialize(OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where ${environment:singlequote} == "all" or Environment == ${environment:singlequote}
| project TraceID, SpanID, ParentID, Service, SpanName, DurationMs=(EndTime - StartTime) / 1ms);
let child_time = spans
    | where not(isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")
    | summarize ChildMs=sum(DurationMs) by TraceID, SpanID=ParentID;
spans
| join kind=leftouter child_time on TraceID, SpanID
| extend SelfMs=max_of(0.0, DurationMs - coalesce(ChildMs, 0.0))
| where ${service:singlequote} == "all" or Service == ${service:singlequote}
| summarize P95SelfMs=percentile(SelfMs, 95) by Operation=strcat(Service, " / ", SpanName)
| top 10 by P95SelfMs desc
